headline: Pakistan Reports Sluggish Export Growth and Widening Trade Deficit
summary: Pakistan's merchandise exports recorded single-digit growth to $11.34 billion in the first four months of fiscal year 2027, while the trade deficit widened due to rising imports.
why: Macroeconomic trade data for emerging markets like Pakistan dictate foreign exchange reserve levels, currency stability, and IMF program compliance.

impacts.name: Pakistan
impacts.why: A widening trade deficit puts pressure on foreign exchange reserves and currency stability.
